description: Full-text message search over Thunderbird's Gloda global index (the search bar's engine), for the mail_search tool.

functions.name: searchMessages
functions.description: Full-text search over the Gloda global message index — the same engine the Thunderbird search bar uses. Terms are AND-combined by default (FTS3); quoted phrases match contiguously. Resolves to an array of {uri, folderUri, messageKey, subject, date}.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Search text; split into terms on spaces, double-quoted spans are phrases.

functions.name: status
functions.description: Gloda indexer status (is the global index enabled?). Resolves to {enabled}.
